name: ai-sales-engine
description: BotBuilders AI Sales Engines: guided builds for your offer, your sales webinar, and your online course, read from your BotBuilders skills library.

interface.shortDescription: Build your offer, sales webinar, and course, by BotBuilders.
interface.longDescription: Three guided Engines that work with you in short phases: Offer Generator designs and pressure-tests an offer you can sell, Webinar Creator builds a sales webinar down to every slide, and Course Builder turns what you know into a finished course and build plan. Each keeps one Blueprint up to date and never invents results, proof, or urgency.
defaultPrompt: I want to sell something. Where do I start?
Help me build a sales webinar for my offer.
I want to turn what I know into an online course.
